profiles.name: Leisure & parks
profiles.blurb: Busier on weekends than on working days; trips start and end mid-afternoon.

profiles.name: All-day mixers
profiles.blurb: Busy and balanced from morning to night: interchanges and nightlife.

profiles.name: Office core
profiles.blurb: Fills up 7–10 am, empties 4–7 pm; nearly silent at weekends.

profiles.name: Residential streets
profiles.blurb: Gentle morning outflow and evening return, quieter overall.

profiles.name: Workplaces & campuses
profiles.blurb: Morning arrivals, evening departures, with steady daytime and weekend use.
